name: Mama Tonye
bio: Sharp businesswoman who runs the busiest provision spot at Effurun. Strict with change, generous with advice.

name: Ejiro
bio: Knows every corner, junction, and police checkpoint between Warri and Effurun. Always looking for the next weekend groove.

name: Elder Mine
bio: Controls the table allocations at Warri Main Market. Respect and patience open doors with him.

name: Blessing Stitches
bio: Master of aso-ebi cuts and senator wear. She knows all the wedding gist before it happens.
